blocks.text: Five Mrs. beauty queens are stepping into a new spotlight as they make their big-screen debut in “Titulada,” an upcoming Filipino advocacy film that explores women’s struggles, resilience and empowerment. Directed by Kent Martin Dy and produced by Richard Hiñola II, the film introduces eight empowered women whose stories revolve around taking control of their lives and fighting for their rights. It also stars actresses Ara Mina and Patricia Javier.
